text.en: Sangam poets praised rulers who protected their people and the land.

Purananuru is a Sangam anthology of 400 poems on the outer life (புறம்): war, charity, governance and the ways of the world. The poem in the textbook is a memorisation poem that shows the greatness of the Tamil tradition in the Sangam period.
Purananuru speaks of virtues such as generosity, courage and justice, and it is valued for its picture of ancient Tamil society. Poems such as these inspire us to be kind and just.
Terms: புறநானூறு, புறப்பொருள் (outer themes), எட்டுத்தொகை (eight anthologies) and சங்க இலக்கியம். It has four hundred poems.
